# PJHQ Patch - TRF UKAF

A config-only compatibility and balance patch for TRF UKAF. It normalizes helmet and vest protection and removes soldier gear proxy classes from Eden/Zeus placement without removing equipment from the Arsenal.

## What It Changes

- Rebalances **13 helmets** and **24 vests** across 4 component patches.
- Hides **103 unique classes** from Eden/Zeus placement using 121 declarations. 18 PCS proxy classes overlap between the insignia component patches.
- Changes config values only. This project contains no replacement models, textures, sounds, scripts or event handlers.
- Does not change `scopeArsenal`, so wearable gear remains available in the Arsenal where the source addon exposes it.

## Requirements And Loading

- Arma 3 version 2.18 or newer.
- TRF UKAF and whichever TRF UKAF optional components you use.
- Load this patch after TRF UKAF.
- Component PBOs use `skipWhenMissingDependencies = 1`, allowing patches whose declared source dependency is absent to be skipped.

## Exact Value Changes

The values below are compared from HEMTT JSON output. `From` values come from the tracked baseline snapshot generated from extracted TRF UKAF configs; `To` values come from temporary patch configs with project-rooted macro includes resolved. Refresh the baseline after upstream updates.

### Helmet Protection

| Area | Property       | From        | To          | Baseline status                |
| ---- | -------------- | ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| Head | `hitpointName` | `"HitHead"` | `"HitHead"` | Verified; reassigned unchanged |
| Head | `armor`        | `24`        | `10`        | Verified                       |
| Head | `passThrough`  | `0.1`       | `0.5`       | Verified                       |

### Vest Protection

| Area      | Property       | From                                      | To               | Baseline status                |
| --------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Neck      | `hitpointName` | Not declared; inherited value unavailable | `"HitNeck"`      | Unavailable; inherited         |
| Neck      | `armor`        | Not declared; inherited value unavailable | `5`              | Unavailable; inherited         |
| Neck      | `passThrough`  | Not declared; inherited value unavailable | `0.4`            | Unavailable; inherited         |
| Chest     | `hitpointName` | `"HitChest"`                              | `"HitChest"`     | Verified; reassigned unchanged |
| Chest     | `armor`        | `24`                                      | `15`             | Verified                       |
| Chest     | `passThrough`  | `0.1`                                     | `0.2`            | Verified                       |
| Diaphragm | `hitpointName` | `"HitDiaphragm"`                          | `"HitDiaphragm"` | Verified; reassigned unchanged |
| Diaphragm | `armor`        | `24`                                      | `18`             | Verified                       |
| Diaphragm | `passThrough`  | `0.1`                                     | `0.2`            | Verified                       |
| Abdomen   | `hitpointName` | `"HitAbdomen"`                            | `"HitAbdomen"`   | Verified; reassigned unchanged |
| Abdomen   | `armor`        | `24`                                      | `15`             | Verified                       |
| Abdomen   | `passThrough`  | `0.1`                                     | `0.2`            | Verified                       |
| Body      | `hitpointName` | `"HitBody"`                               | `"HitBody"`      | Verified; reassigned unchanged |
| Body      | `armor`        | `24`                                      | `0`              | Verified                       |
| Body      | `passThrough`  | `0.1`                                     | `0.2`            | Verified                       |

The source vest classes did not declare a `Neck` block. The patch adds one, but the effective inherited pre-patch values are unavailable and are not guessed here.

### Eden And Zeus Visibility

| Area               | Property       | From | To  | Baseline status |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ---- | --- | --------------- |
| All target classes | `scope`        | `2`  | `1` | Verified        |
| 103 target classes | `scopeCurator` | `2`  | `0` | Verified        |

## Building And Documentation

```bash
hemtt check
hemtt dev
hemtt release
bun run docs
bun run docs:refresh
bun run docs:check
```

`bun run docs` regenerates this file and `WORKSHOP.md` from converted patch configs and the tracked baseline. `bun run docs:refresh` first rebuilds the baseline from `source_addons/`. `bun run docs:check` exits with an error when either generated file is stale.
